summary: Real defects the 11-08 publish live gate found (triage: gocli1219-logs/triage.md class a): send-check answers an empty tag/smart-list scope as a clean 0-checked result (exit 0; an unknown --contact is still the API 404); drips audit refuses a non-UUID or second positional (usage error); imports blame/watch take --latest (the account's newest import job; no job is an exit-0 answer); every novel command answers --dry-run --json with the {dry_run, action, would} object; the three text-response endpoints (contacts export, contacts get-import-template, activity) answer --dry-run with it instead of the bare client sentinel; contacts verify-line-type --estimate carries dry_run/action under --dry-run; local-data purge names its action; tail reports an empty page as one {event: empty} line.
reason: The live dogfood matrix (and agents) read --dry-run --json as a contract and an empty stdout or a not-found exit on an empty scope as a failure; the novel commands and three 4.34.2 framework paths broke it.
validated_outcome: TestSendCheckEmptyScopeIsACleanAnswer, TestSendCheckUnknownContactIsStillNotFound, TestDripsAuditRefusesAJunkCampaignID, TestNovelDryRunJSONIsADryRunObject, TestImportsLatestResolvesTheNewestJob, TestVerifyLineTypeEstimateUnderDryRunCarriesTheMarker, TestTailEmptyPageEmitsOneEvent, TestLocalDataPurgeDryRunNamesItsAction; the FULL live gate against the demo workspace passes.
